name: Zelta Design
description: Zelta Design is a full-service architecture firm in Nutley, New Jersey, specializing in restaurant and commercial projects. The firm has completed over 2,500 projects for +40 brands and works nationwide, licensed in 25 states and adding states as clients need them. It handles a project end to end: site survey, schematic design, construction documents, permitting and plan review, code and accessibility compliance, MEP coordination and construction administration.

capabilities.name: Architecture
capabilities.description: Space planning, layout options and renderings, followed by plans, elevations and detailed construction documents.

capabilities.name: Permitting
capabilities.description: Applications, submissions and approval tracking. We respond to local plan-review comments and manage resubmittals.

capabilities.name: Code Compliance
capabilities.description: Building, fire, health and accessibility requirements reviewed as part of the design.

capabilities.name: Coordination
capabilities.description: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural and site design coordinated with the architectural documents.

process.name: Survey
process.description: Existing conditions, landlord drawings, site verification.

process.name: Schematic Design
process.description: Test fits, layout options and renderings, code analysis up front.

process.name: Documents
process.description: Sealed documents coordinated across every discipline.

process.name: Construction
process.description: RFI response, submittals, inspections and closeout.
